scope: Reviewed gameplay Blueprint defaults/bytecode, placed spring/water geometry, bounded audio and transform VFX evidence

validation.note: VM widths validate offsets, not runtime reachability. Godot verification belongs to coordinator.

spawn.gm_begin: Save current pawn location and default bird type0
spawn.checkpoint: Save checkpoint actor location and CURRENT ability type

pickup.art: Unlock pickups have looping NPC idle flipbooks; no collection-specific animation in compiled Apply path.

destruct: If not already broken set HasTriggeredBroken=true

spring.compiled_callbacks: ReceiveBeginPlay and ReceiveActorBeginOverlap are 3-byte no-op functions
spring.godot_bounce_classification: Intended restoration; not equivalent to saved no-op callbacks
spring.cooldown_note: No confirmed source cooldown; Godot0.15s is a guard.

water.native_bug: HeronPlayer sets bIsInWater=true before EnterWater; EnterWater returns when true. ExitWater also returns after end-overlap cleared the flag.
water.godot_policy: Apply intended Mallard water modifiers and restore on exit; count overlapping waters
water.water_plane: Visual only; static mesh Plane explicitly NoCollision, separate from tagged water trigger
water.geometry_rule: Use root instance scale once; instance values override template0.5.

transform_vfx.call_coverage_note: No PlayHenshinVFX declaration or invocation in current Source; name occurs only in child Blueprint among gameplay Blueprint JSON.
unresolved: Particle lifetime, spawn radius, color and burst count: serialized NiagaraVariableWithOffset values are empty in UAssetAPI; ParameterData alone cannot identify them.
FixedBounds are culling bounds, not spawn radius.
Automatic event invocation requires intended restoration; saved event alone does not prove reachability.
Native node defaults for unbound pins, including repeat policy
Sample-accurate envelopes, transitions, and mix gain
bgm.note: No explicit Delay node name in this asset; do not infer a playlist delay from defaults.
bgm.behavior: Random playlist selection on start and after WavePlayer.OnFinished; OnNext attacks ADSR, OnNearlyFinished releases ADSR, envelope controls stereo Gain0.

audio.land_offset_note: WavePlayer.Start Time is sample position, not a trigger delay.
gaps: Godot sample playback does not reproduce all MetaSound envelopes and mixer levels.
Random cue no-repeat semantics and sample-accurate looping need separate verification.
